stem: Why was the Third Amendment prohibiting the quartering of troops added to the U.S. Constitution?

options.label: F
options.text: To address colonial treatment by the British military

options.label: G
options.text: To maintain control over members of the British military

options.label: H
options.text: To ensure the national government could pay for the U.S. military

options.label: J
options.text: To reinforce the need for state militias in the United States
